gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.

gaps.sentence: The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
